mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Steakhouse High Yield USDC (bbqUSDC) at ethereum:0xbeeff2c5bf38f90e3482a8b19f12e5a6d2fca757 is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0xbfe734baab130048e20a64e800c4c2ec25756284 holds 10 enumerated Morpho market IDs. This intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent and older Morpho precedent classifications. The exact deployment launch date is 2025-10-27, established by Morpho creationTimestamp for this chain-qualified vault address (1761601787). Published VaultV2 framework security audits corroborate the referenced semantics; source-to-bytecode completeness and financial assurance are separate facts.
